question.problem:
Maria collects stickers for a sticker album, where each sticker in the album has a different number on it.
So far, Maria has duplicates of the following sticker numbers:

$$
7,\,12,\,28,\,35,\,78,\,81,\,99,\,112
$$

If Maria picks a duplicate sticker at random to give to a friend, what is the probability that the sticker number she picks is greater than $70?$
question.worked_solution:
Let $X$ represent the number on the chosen sticker. From the problem statement, we know that $X∼U\{7,\,12,\,28,\,35,\,78,\,81,\,99,\,112\},$ and we wish to compute $P(X>70).$

In general, if $X$ follows a discrete uniform distribution over a set $S,$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{|S|}, & x\in S \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, we have $X∼U\{7,\,12,\,28,\,35,\,78,\,81,\,99,\,112\},$ and the set $S=\{7,\,12,\,28,\,35,\,78,\,81,\,99,\,112\}$ has $|S|=8$ items. So, we have

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{8}, & x=7,\,12,\,28,\,35,\,78,\,81,\,99,\,112 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

In $S,$ the items that satisfy $X>70$ are $78,\,81,\,99,\,112.$ There are $4$ of these items. Therefore,

$$
P(X>70)=4\cdot \frac{1}{8}=\frac{4}{8}=\frac{1}{2}.
$$
